items.content_html: AutoStory Studio is a Python desktop app that automates the story-to-video workflow. It generates TikTok-style scripts from raw text with GPT-5 Mini, synthesizes narration with ElevenLabs, creates beat-based images and animations with MidJourney via Discord, and exports organized project folders ready for editing in CapCut.
